workflows.yaml:
name: Java CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
      - run: mvn -B verify

children.name: vw_student_performance
children.ddl: CREATE VIEW vw_student_performance AS SELECT s.student_name,c.course_name,e.score,e.grade FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON e.student_id=s.student_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id;

children.name: sp_students_at_risk
children.ddl: CREATE PROCEDURE sp_students_at_risk() BEGIN SELECT * FROM student WHERE risk_status='At Risk'; END;

children.name: fn_grade_label
children.ddl: CREATE FUNCTION fn_grade_label(score DECIMAL(5,2)) RETURNS VARCHAR(20) RETURN IF(score>=90,'Excellent',IF(score>=80,'Good','Needs Support'));

children.name: evt_weekly_summary
children.ddl: CREATE EVENT evt_weekly_summary ON SCHEDULE EVERY 1 WEEK DO INSERT INTO audit_log(message) VALUES('weekly summary');

queryTabs.title: student_analysis.sql
queryTabs.sql:
SELECT
    s.student_id,
    s.student_name,
    c.course_name,
    e.score,
    e.grade
FROM student s
JOIN enrollment e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id
ORDER BY e.score DESC;

  namespace: campus-dev
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: student-api

      labels:
        app: student-api
    spec:

        image: ghcr.io/campus/student-api:1.8.4
        ports:
